items.title_hi: UAE signals another $25 billion investment in India; eyes ports, energy and space sectors: Goyal
items.detail_en: India and the UAE have set a target of doubling bilateral trade to $200 billion by 2032 after trade reached around $100 billion. The target was agreed by the two countries earlier this year.
